name: Alexandria Real Estate Equities

profile.summary: Alexandria Real Estate Equities, Inc., is a mission-driven life science REIT. The firm is pioneered the life science real estate niche. The firm is the preeminent and longest-tenured owner, operator and developer of collaborative Megacampus ecosystems in AAA life science and advanced technology innovation cluster locations, including Greater Boston, the San Francisco Bay Area, San Diego, Seattle, Maryland, Research Triangle and New York City. Alexandria Real Estate Equities, Inc. was established on 5th January 1994 and was incorporated in Maryland.
